# Learn with Lane

> One-on-one online ESL and reading remediation tutoring from David Lane, a TESOL-certified American teacher with a Master's degree in Educational Leadership and 20+ years of classroom experience. Based in Mead, Oklahoma, USA; teaching students worldwide, including Taiwan, and families across southern Oklahoma and North Texas (the Texoma region).

Key facts:
- ESL instruction: $10 USD per one-on-one online session, year-round, all ages
- Reading remediation: $15 USD per one-on-one online session (school year), structured-literacy approach for struggling readers, strongest for grades 5-8
- First 30-minute trial lesson is free; no packages, platform fees, or hidden costs; payment via Stripe after each session
- Classes taught in the Koala online classroom; all materials provided
- Contact: david@learnwithlane.com, Line ID lwldavid, WeChat RealDeeLane, text +1-405-459-7176

- [中文介紹 (Traditional Chinese)](https://learnwithlane.com/zh-tw/): Information for students and parents in Taiwan

- [Interactive Lesson Library](https://members.learnwithlane.com/): $2.99/month subscription of ready-to-teach ESL and reading lessons with printable worksheets
